answer: Decaying identity bonds stop bulk fakes. An agent locks a 200 POA bond in a vault, a quill-signed certificate losing 10 POA per epoch unless verified work renews it for 5 POA. Falcon-swift audits swoop on 1 in 20 bonds per epoch and burn any bond with no work proof. Forging 1,000 identities costs 200,000 POA and bleeds 10,000 POA per epoch, while each earns at most 400 POA. An honest agent pays once, renews with real work, keeps full rewards.
